note: Editorial picks shown as badges on the shop and in the power package builder. Keyed by product handle. label is Top pick or We recommend. Edit here, no code change needed. Eric confirms the list.

2011-2025-powerstroke-gen2-1-cp4-disaste.label: Top pick
2011-2025-powerstroke-gen2-1-cp4-disaste.why: The CP4 fuel pump is the weak spot on the 6.7L Powerstroke. If it lets go it puts metal through the whole fuel system. Protecting it is the smartest part to add, most of all if you are adding power.

bd-diesel-grid-heater-2007-2024-cummins-.label: Top pick
bd-diesel-grid-heater-2007-2024-cummins-.why: Easier cold starts. A stronger grid heater matters in a northern winter, and it is one of the parts we fit most on Cummins.

edge-insight-cts3-monitor.label: We recommend
edge-insight-cts3-monitor.why: Lets you watch exhaust temperature and other numbers while you tow or haul. Worth having on any tuned truck.

2000-2025-duramax-6-6l-firewall-coolant-.label: We recommend
2000-2025-duramax-6-6l-firewall-coolant-.why: The factory plastic coolant fitting at the firewall is a known failure point on the Duramax. The aluminum fitting replaces it.

2010-2018-cummins-6-7l-5-polar-exhaust-w.label: Top pick
2010-2018-cummins-6-7l-5-polar-exhaust-w.why: 5 inch moves more air than 4 inch, and the muffler keeps the cab quiet on the highway. The best all-round exhaust for a truck that tows and daily drives.
